snippet.title: Breakremental | Official Gameplay Trailer | Incremental Brick Breaker
snippet.description:
What happens when you combine classic brick breaking with incremental upgrades? Things get out of hand pretty quickly. 😁

🎮 WISHLIST BREAKREMENTAL ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5395800/Breakremental/

Start with a single ball, smash bricks, earn coins and unlock upgrades that turn a simple brick breaker into absolute chaos!

- Upgrade your balls and increase your damage
- Unlock new abilities and upgrades
- Fight challenging bosses
- Progress through increasingly difficult levels
- Earn coins and keep getting stronger

Breakremental is an upcoming 2D incremental brick breaker developed by Wolverine Island.

The free demo is on its way, so stay tuned!

📅 Planned release: March 1, 2027
🎮 Platform: PC (Steam)

If Breakremental looks like your kind of game, consider adding it to your Steam wishlist. It really helps us out!
